(3) The Minister may on the advice of the Council, by
Order  published  in  the  Gazette,  specify  the  maximum
capacity of any renewable energy technology-based power
plants  which  may  be  permitted  to  enter  into  standardized
power  purchase  agreements  with  the  National  System
Operator:
Provided  that,  the  maximum  capacity  of  such
renewable energy plants to be procured from a contiguous
location  using  standard  power  purchase  agreements  on
cumulative basis shall not exceed 10 MW, which shall be
further reduced by an order made by the Minister published
in  the  Gazette,  once  the  regulations  prescribing  the
procedures for competitive procurement of new capacity are
in  place:
Provided further, any electricity project located within
the territory of Sri Lanka and the Sri Lanka Waters which
may  involve  electricity  exports  shall  be  undertaken  only
with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers.
